description: Get route alternatives, multi-stop trips, turn-by-turn steps, traffic, transit detail, distance matrices and directions URLs from Google Maps.

avoidFerries.description: Driving only — prefer routes without ferry crossings. If every route uses a ferry, the result is still returned and marked with avoidanceUnmet.
avoidFerries.title: Avoid Ferries

avoidHighways.description: Driving only — ask Google Maps to avoid highways and motorways. If no practical alternative exists, Google may still return a highway route.
avoidHighways.title: Avoid Highways

avoidTolls.description: Driving only — ask Google Maps to avoid toll roads. If no toll-free route exists, Google may still return a toll route.
avoidTolls.title: Avoid Tolls

departureTime.description: Optional ISO 8601 departure time as local time at the origin, for example 2026-06-16T10:30:00. Used for driving traffic estimates and transit schedules. A timezone offset is accepted but ignored; walking and bicycling ignore the field.
departureTime.title: Departure Time

destinations.description: Ending locations for matrix mode. Each destination is paired with every origin above.
destinations.title: Destinations

directionsUrls.description: Google Maps directions links for URLs mode. Canonical /maps/dir/ links and short share links are both accepted; waypoints and travel mode are read from the link when present.
directionsUrls.title: Directions URLs

includeSteps.description: Add turn-by-turn steps with instruction, distance, duration, maneuver, coordinates and route geometry for every returned route.
includeSteps.title: Include Steps

includeStreetView.description: Add a Street View panorama ID and thumbnail URL to each step where Google publishes one. This also enables step details.
includeStreetView.title: Include Street View

language.description: Language for instructions and other localized text.
language.title: Language

maxAlternatives.description: Maximum number of route alternatives to return per trip, including Google's recommended route. Applies to route and URLs modes. Google usually supplies up to 3 alternatives.
maxAlternatives.title: Max Alternatives

maxItems.description: Global cap on the number of records pushed to the dataset.
maxItems.title: Max Results

maxPairs.description: Maximum number of origin × destination pairs to request in matrix mode. Pairs beyond this cap are left out.
maxPairs.title: Max Pairs

mode.description: What to scrape: one route (with optional waypoints), a distance matrix, or a list of Google Maps directions URLs.
mode.title: Mode

origins.description: Starting locations for matrix mode. Each origin is paired with every destination below.
prefill: Grand Central Terminal, New York, NY
origins.title: Origins

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional fallback proxy. The actor first requests Google Maps directly and only retries through this proxy if the direct request is blocked.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

requestDelayMs.description: Pause between directions requests. A small delay keeps large matrix runs polite and reduces rate limiting.
requestDelayMs.title: Request Delay (ms)

stops.description: Ordered stops for route mode: 2–10 locations. The first is the origin, the last is the destination, and everything in between becomes a waypoint.
stops.title: Stops

travelMode.description: How to travel between the stops.
travelMode.title: Travel Mode

units.description: Preferred distance units for the formatted distance fields. Meter values stay unchanged.
units.title: Units

title: Google Maps Directions Scraper
